messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Elevated 5xx spike observed at edge gateway — automated SLO alert. initial rate ~18% 5xx across gateway-proxy routes. paging primary oncall @maya. correlation ids sample attached.
maya: seeing the spike in dashboards — latency up, 504s are majority. rolling error rate graph: https://dashboards.internal/rdw/gateway/errors?from=~10m
eli: I can join. what's the impact window and are customers impacted? any error budget burning?
maya: customer impact: ~2% of requests for top 3 customers, 18% across internal test traffic. Several live PROD customers reported degraded responses. SLO alerting flipped ~3m ago.
john: log tailing shows repeated upstream reset errors and lots of upstream retries in short bursts. suspect retry amplification. sample log lines:

```
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z | cid=abc123 | upstream=runtime-9 | status=504 | msg="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z | cid=abc123 | retry=1 | upstream=runtime-9 | msg="retrying request"
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z | cid=abc123 | retry=2 | upstream=runtime-11 | msg="upstream reset"
```

maya: thanks john. correlation id abc123 maps to the failing trace; adding to timeline.
sam: quick ask — any recent deploys to gateway or runtime around X:00? deploy-bot show?
deploy-bot: @sam deployment: gateway/nginx-proxy v2.4.1 promoted at 02:00 UTC (author: @jen). Config delta: decreased proxy_read_timeout from 90s -> 10s and enabled keepalive_reuse.
jen: that config change was to catch hung connections. didn't anticipate changing to 10s would interact with upstream slow tails. rolling back? canary only hit some regions.
maya: mitigations to try: 1) roll gateway back to v2.4.0 canary -> 2) enable fallback routing to dedicated runtime pool -> 3) throttle upstream retries at edge.
eli: can we produce a quick patch to short-circuit retry logic? otherwise rollback gateway canary.
john: attaching more log context for cid abc123: shows repeated client->gateway->runtime handoffs. Upstream latency clusters at 9s before endpoint times out.

```
# query example to fetch traces
curl -H "X-Correlation-ID: abc123" https://traces.internal/lookup?cid=abc123
```

ops-bot: quick health check: region-us-west error-rate 21% for gateway-proxy routes, overall QPS down 14%.
maya: ok roll decision: initiate rollback of gateway canary in us-west and enable route fallback to dedicated pool for the most affected routes. @jen can you run the rollback? @sam pls prepare rate-limiting rule for upstream retries.
jen: rolling back canary now (start 02:07). status: rollout paused -> rollback in progress.
sam: prepping runtime retry throttle: adding header-based short-circuit at edge to cap retries to 1 per request. pushing rule to staging -> will promote to canary in ~2m.

```
# mitigation commands
kubectl -n gateway rollout undo deployment/nginx-proxy --to-revision=174
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/fallback -d '{"route": "/v1/complete", "target":"dedicated-pool"}'
```

maya: while rollback proceeds, collect full kvlog dump for correlation ids with >3 retries. john pls gather and share blob id.
john: kvlog dump uploaded: s3://logs/incident-1799123456/kvlog-20260315-0208.tar.gz
maya: tracker: timeline building in this thread. hypothesis A: gateway timeout reduction -> earlier upstream timeouts -> client retries -> retry amplification -> backpressure on runtimes -> more 504s. hypothesis B: sudden load increase on runtime pool + slow tail latency causing upstream resets. vote? :one: for A, :two: for B
eli: :one: from me — logs show retries immediately after gateway timeouts.
jen: :one: — matching deploy delta timing.
sam: implementing retry cap now, will announce canary once applied.
ops-bot: customer impact update: customer-alpha (top customer) experienced 3.4% failed calls in window, support tickets opened. CS notified.
maya: mitigation results: rollback completed 02:12, gateway error-rate dropped from 21% -> 6% within 90s. enabling retry cap now.
sam: retry cap active in canary region at 02:14. early telemetry shows retries reduced by ~80% and runtime tail latencies falling.

```
# quick post-mit metrics
before: gateway 5xx 18%, avg runtime tail 9s
after rollback+cap: gateway 5xx 5.8%, avg runtime tail 1.2s
```

maya: ok urgent mitigations effective. next steps: continue capturing full traces for RCA, collect timeline, assign RCA lead. I'll take RCA lead; @eli you own timeline + log bundle parsing. @john gather full kvlogs and runtime metrics. @jen to file deploy postmortem re: config change rationale and safeguards.
eli: got it — I'll assemble timeline with per-cid traces and put in doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/1799123456/timeline
john: uploading additional logs and link to traces: s3://logs/incident-1799123456/expanded/
jen: will open PR to make proxy_read_timeout configurable per route and add a canary gating check for timeouts.
maya: final note in-thread: customer impact assessed, mitigations successful, prepping RCA. adding incident tag, scheduling follow-up review at 15:00 UTC. closing live pager for now. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INCIDENT: pager resolved. follow-up RCA required. severity: Sev2. assigned: maya (lead), eli (timeline), john (logs), jen (deploy postmortem), sam (retry policy)
